title: Attacker
description: An attacker IP (ip_intel document, `_id` renamed to `ip`). `geo` is absent until a location has been looked up.

geo.description: Location saved on an attacker by the API. When found=false only found, looked_up_at and source are present. Accuracy depends on the database (DB-IP Lite has no accuracy radius). Treat every field as optional.

looked_up_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Normally UTC with offset (Z or +00:00). Rows stored before scripts/migrate_timestamps.py was run may lack an offset; treat those as UTC.

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Normally UTC with offset (Z or +00:00). Rows stored before scripts/migrate_timestamps.py was run may lack an offset; treat those as UTC.

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Normally UTC with offset (Z or +00:00). Rows stored before scripts/migrate_timestamps.py was run may lack an offset; treat those as UTC.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Normally UTC with offset (Z or +00:00). Rows stored before scripts/migrate_timestamps.py was run may lack an offset; treat those as UTC.

items.description: ATT&CK technique id, e.g. T1082 or T1110.001. Heuristic tag, not a confirmed technique.

techniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ids matched by the rule set in app/mitre.py (heuristic). Absent on rows stored before the MITRE backfill ran.
